title: Portable delegation-horizon record
description: One scored record in a form any system can import: a hiring platform, an HR file, a learning platform, a research database (Section 10.3 of the paper). It carries the record line and everything a reader needs to read it fairly, and it points back to the log by a hash, so the receiving system can ask for the log and confirm it is the one that was scored. record_card.py --format json writes it.

person.description: The pseudonymous label used in the log; the holder links it to a name, the record never does

domain.description: A rung holds for this domain only

gain.description: Verified reference hours per hour of attention, last 91 days, failures included

as_of.description: Scoring date; the rung is confirmed again every quarter

pieces.description: Pieces logged in the last 91 days

not_verified.description: Failed, abandoned or not independently checked pieces, kept in the count

checks.description: Kinds of independent check behind the verified pieces

irreversible.description: Pieces whose mistakes cannot be undone

outside_help.description: Pieces with help off the log (excluded from gain)

directive_share.description: Share of pieces handed over in one piece

sha256.description: Hash of the scorer that produced the record, so rule changes are visible

log_sha256.description: Hash of the log file as scored
